Namida Paddle geometry and development reference fixtures
========================================================

PaddleDbPostProcess.ts and PaddleCropGeometry.ts contain TypeScript adaptations
of the algorithms below, reduced to the operations required by the local OCR
pipeline. They replace C++/NumPy containers and runtime calls with typed arrays,
explicit arithmetic, and the separately licensed JavaScript Clipper dependency.
